claim_boundary: This artifact removes the continuous n-Poisson mode and derives the nonzero ell~K saddle map. It proves no bound for those aliases, simple-root closure, complete moment, density, or intervals.

radial_mean_alias_theorem.alias_support: n~Q and H~H0~KQ/D with c~D force ell~K
radial_mean_alias_theorem.boundary: the continuous volume term is removed, but no bound for the nonzero ell~K aliases, simple-root sum, complete moment, density, or prime intervals is proved
radial_mean_alias_theorem.kernel: K_H0(y)=H0 hat(U)(-H0 y), with U smooth and compactly supported in (0,infinity)
radial_mean_alias_theorem.nonzero_geometry: Phi_ell(n*)=Hc[log(p0Hc/(ell S))-1], |Phi_ell''(n*)|=ell^2/(Hc), and stationary amplitude sqrt(Hc)/ell=n*/sqrt(Hc)~sqrt(Q/K)
radial_mean_alias_theorem.nonzero_saddle: a stationary point exists only for ell>0 and is n*=Hc/ell, equivalently A*=p0Hc/ell
radial_mean_alias_theorem.vanishing_moments: int y^j K_H0(y)dy=0 for every j>=0 because U^(j)(0)=0
radial_mean_alias_theorem.zero_mode: after y=c log(p0 n/S), the zero n-Poisson mode is O_N((Q/c)(cH0)^(-N)) for every N, uniformly for bounded p0 and fixed smooth compact supports

remaining_target.statement: bound the ell~K entropy aliases with the Cycle-121 arithmetic weight or extract a phase-aware inverse
